timeline.summary: 24 Apr 2026: CRISIL reaffirmed Solar Industries at AA+ and revised the outlook to Positive from Stable, withdrawing the rating on a fully redeemed ₹15 Cr NCD tranche.

Kailash Chandra Nuwal, Founder and Promoter of Solar Industries India Limited, declared no encumbrance on shares by him, his family (Mrs. Indira Kailashchandra Nuwal and Mr. Rahul Nuwal) or persons acting in concert, on 4th April 2026.
Sohan Devi Nand Lal Nuwal Family Trust declared no encumbrance on Solar Industries India Limited shares on 4 April 2026.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹3,052.75 Cr, net profit to shareholders ₹547.63 Cr.
15 May 2026: Q4FY26/FY26 investor presentation guides FY27 revenue to ₹14,000 Cr and capex to ₹2,050 Cr, with a ₹21,300 Cr order book and FY26 revenue up 30% to ₹9,838 Cr.
Solar Industries India Limited shared the earnings conference call recording link for Q4FY26 results on May 15, 2026, hosted by Motilal Oswal Financial Services Limited.
18 May 2026: Q4FY26 earnings call transcript reiterates FY27 revenue guidance of ₹14,000 Cr, defence target of ₹4,500 Cr and capex of ₹2,050 Cr.
Kailash Chandra Nuwal, Founder and Promoter, declared no encumbrance on Solar Industries India shares for KC Nuwal Group on April 4, 2026.
On May 29, 2026, Solar Industries secured an export defence order worth ₹1,076 Cr.

Solar Industries' step-down subsidiary signed definitive agreements to acquire South Africa's Omnia Holdings for $1.35 billion in cash, with management guiding combined FY28 revenue of ₹31,000-32,000 Cr.
Solar Industries' subsidiary Solar Explochem agreed to acquire Sivasakthi Industrial Explosives for ₹115.02 Cr on October 15, 2026.
